title: Azure Terraform Infrastructure Input
description: User-editable JSON input for creating Azure resource groups and optional virtual networks and subnets. Azure location is fixed to Central US by Terraform.

subscription_id.title: Azure subscription ID
subscription_id.description: Required Azure subscription GUID where resources will be created. Replace the example placeholder with your subscription ID.

resource_groups.title: Resource groups
resource_groups.description: Each object creates one Azure resource group. Add or remove objects to control how many resource groups are provisioned. Location is fixed to Central US.

name.title: Resource group name
name.description: Azure resource group name: 1-90 characters; letters, numbers, underscore, parentheses, hyphen and period are allowed. Must not end with a period. Names must be unique, ignoring case.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Optional Azure tags as string key/value pairs. Recommended: environment and managed_by.

virtual_network.title: Virtual network (optional)
virtual_network.description: Include this property only when this resource group needs a virtual network. Omit it to create only the resource group.

name.title: Virtual network name
name.description: VNet name: 2-64 characters; letters, numbers, underscore, period and hyphen are allowed.

address_space.title: VNet address space
address_space.description: One or more IPv4/IPv6 CIDR address ranges assigned to the virtual network, for example 10.10.0.0/16.

subnets.title: Subnets (optional)
subnets.description: Optional list of subnets inside this VNet. Add one object per subnet.

name.title: Subnet name
name.description: Subnet name: 1-80 characters; letters, numbers, underscore, period and hyphen are allowed. Names within the same VNet must be unique, ignoring case.

address_prefixes.title: Subnet address prefixes
address_prefixes.description: One or more CIDR address ranges for the subnet, for example 10.10.1.0/24. Ensure each subnet range is within the VNet address space and does not overlap other subnets.
